dify_private_disclosure.title: Missing TOOL_MANAGE Permission Check on Remote API Schema Fetch Endpoint
dify_private_disclosure.body:
**Issue Description**

The remote API schema preparation endpoint allows an authenticated workspace member without `TOOL_MANAGE` permission to trigger a server-side HTTP request and retrieve a remote OpenAPI schema.

Unlike the adjacent API Tool creation endpoint, this endpoint does not enforce the `TOOL_MANAGE` permission.
dify_private_disclosure.security_policy:
# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in Dify, please report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories:

https://github.com/langgenius/dify/security/advisories/new

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.

When submitting a report, include as much relevant information as you can safely provide, such as:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce, if safe to share privately
- Affected components, versions, or configurations
- Potential impact
- Any suggested mitigation or fix, if available

The maintainers will review reports submitted through GitHub Security Advisories and coordinate follow-up there.

## Public Disclosure

Please avoid publicly disclosing details of a vulnerability until it has been reviewed and, where appropriate, a fix or mitigation has been made available.

## Security Updates

Security fixes may be released through normal project releases or other appropriate channels. Users are encouraged to keep Dify deployments up to date.
dify_private_disclosure.contribution_excerpt: For security vulnerabilities, follow our [security policy](./SECURITY.md) and report privately instead of opening a public issue.

qwen_prerequisite.title: fix(core): key persisted-output stub detection on ToolOutputRecovery.persistedOutputFiles
qwen_prerequisite.body:
Follow-up from #16598 (R1-1). That PR taught `isPersistedOutputStub` to recognise the tag and path line shapes, so microcompaction no longer clears a persisted-output stub in the two common formats.

Two producers still match neither branch:

- the finalizer's `Persisted tool-output artifact: <path>` header
- `web_fetch`'s `Full extracted text saved to: <path>` note, behind its metadata header

Widening the positional read one spelling at a time finds one more producer each round. The class is *the saved path is not at offset 0*.

comments.author: qwen-code-review-bot

A maintainer call is worth having on whether to widen #16598 in place — same predicate, same defect class, and the fix reportedly originated in that review — or keep this separate; a separate PR means the string-fallback branch gets written twice.
